mapper.select: SELECT S.SCHEDULE_CODE AS VALUE , S.SCHEDULE_NAME AS NAME FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE S WHERE S.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND S.SYSTEM_BATCH_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN S.APPLY_FROM_DATE AND COALESCE(NULLIF(S.APPLY_TO_DATE, ''), '99991231') ORDER BY S.SCHEDULE_CODE

SELECT M.IF_CODE AS VALUE , COALESCE(I.IF_NAME, M.IF_CODE) AS NAME FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE_MAPPING M LEFT JOIN INTERFACE_ITEM_MST I ON I.IF_CODE = M.IF_CODE AND I.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND M.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{schedule_code} AND M.AUTO_BATCH_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(I.USING_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY M.SCHEDULE_SEQ

SELECT S.EXECUTION_PROGRAM , M.PROCEDURE_ID FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE S JOIN INTERFACE_SCHEDULE_MAPPING M ON M.SCHEDULE_CODE = S.SCHEDULE_CODE AND M.COMPANY_CODE = S.COMPANY_CODE AND M.IF_CODE = #{if_code} WHERE S.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND S.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{schedule_code} AND S.SYSTEM_BATCH_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

SELECT T.INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS_ID , T.IF_CODE , COALESCE(I.IF_NAME, T.IF_CODE) AS IF_NAME , T.TOTAL_ROWS , TO_CHAR(T.START_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS START_TIME , TO_CHAR(T.TRANS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRANS_DATE , T.TRANS_STATUS , CASE T.TRANS_STATUS WHEN '0' THEN 'running' WHEN '1' THEN 'succeed' WHEN '2' THEN 'failed' ELSE T.TRANS_STATUS END AS TRANS_STATUS_NAME , T.IF_PARAM , T.ERROR_YN , T.ERROR_MESSAGE FROM INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS T LEFT JOIN INTERFACE_ITEM_MST I ON I.IF_CODE = T.IF_CODE AND I.COMPANY_CODE = T.COMPANY_CODE WHERE T.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code}
AND T.TRANS_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{search_from_date}, 'YYYYMMDD')
AND T.TRANS_DATE < TO_DATE(#{search_to_date}, 'YYYYMMDD') + INTERVAL '1 day'
AND T.IF_CODE ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
AND I.IF_NAME ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{search_keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY T.TRANS_DATE DESC, T.INTG_INTERFACE_TRANS_ID DESC

SELECT 'attribute' || LPAD(X.RN::VARCHAR, 2, '0') AS DATA_FIELD , COALESCE(NULLIF(X.COLUMN_NAME, ''), X.TARGET_COLUMN) AS HEADER_TEXT FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY D.INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID) AS RN , D.COLUMN_NAME , D.TARGET_COLUMN FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL D WHERE D.IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND D.USING_YN = 'Y' ) X WHERE X.RN <= 50 ORDER BY X.RN
